# Data Source: identitynow_managed_cluster_type

Use this data source to look up a managed cluster type by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_managed_cluster_type" "custom" {
  id = "<CLUSTER_TYPE_ID>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Managed cluster type ID.

### Read-Only

- `managed_process_ids` (List of String) IDs of the processes that run on clusters of this type.
- `org` (String) Org the cluster type applies to.
- `pod` (String) Pod the cluster type applies to.
- `type` (String) Name of the cluster type.
